findings.finding: Public Computable::atan recognizes exact rational arguments and constructs AtanRational, whose argument extraction charges a rational read. A raw AtanDeferred(Int) fixture can isolate the private path but does not demonstrate that ordinary construction creates that same shape.
findings.next_measurement: Keep raw-shape helper measurements separate from complete public constructor/query schedules. Inspect the constructed root shape and retained facts before claiming a cold public path.

findings.expression: atan(n + pi) - atan(m + pi), with positive integers n and m of different bit lengths
path: general negate/add constructors for the two argument difference
findings.finding: Deferred atan argument extraction borrows Computable nodes by Arc clone. The term combiner uses budgeted structural equality, whose integer comparison can reject different bit lengths after a node debit. The inverse-trig sign path then constructs an argument difference. General add invokes optional metered inverse-trig collapse, followed by exact_rational and rational_offset_parts; rational_offset_parts can copy exact integer offsets without a shared payload debit. The source ordering motivates checking copies after an unsuccessful optional collapse, but no allowance that exposes such a failure has been measured.
findings.next_measurement: Construct fresh public expressions outside the allocation window; verify no retained root certificate first. Sweep small allowances on fresh graphs, compare with small-width controls, retain full receipts and measure only the synchronous sign query. Use strict monotonicity of atan for the sign oracle, then check generous/unlimited retries and zero-work proof reuse. Include both operand orders and preserve exact cancellation separately.

findings.kind: bounded allocation ordering candidate remains separate
findings.finding: PiLaurentPolynomial::clone_with_work charges one visit and reserves the at-most-eight-term vector before RadicalCoefficient::clone_with_work checks all coefficient reads. The coefficient helper itself preflights its rational, radical and atom coefficients before cloning.
findings.next_measurement: Freeze allowance cutpoints immediately before coefficient copy, plus funded copies and retained contents. Do not treat the bounded vector as an established unbounded resource failure.

findings.finding: sign_until_with_budget returns an immediate root sign before introducing the allowance scope. atan_deferred propagates a known argument sign; add can retain same-sign or constant-plus-rational facts. Cold-query fixtures must account for such legitimate setup-time facts. NodeFacts::new stores hints and supplied bound/sign facts, not a finite-real flag.
